intent: Compile authoritative human product material and the Engineering Constitution into a readiness report, project state, dependency graph, Work Units, risk, context plan and initial staffing. Must run before first runtime activation or after material source changes.
steps: Verify the machine-readable reconciliation baseline and stop if it is missing, incomplete, or stale
Read the constitution, project profile, source registry, registered authoritative product sources, and repository state only as observed reality when relevant
Run Definition of Ready against the requested scope
If blocking ambiguity exists, emit readiness gate issues and stop the affected scope
Build capabilities and features without inventing a new product structure
Decompose into small, observable, testable Work Units
Build explicit dependencies and identify the critical path
Assign risk class from policy and record reasons
Determine required verification from behavior and risk
Build a Context Package plan for each Work Unit
Propose allowlist changes as a diff for human review; do not apply allowlist changes automatically
Update project state and work unit definitions
Produce a concise execution plan summary
Set phase to awaiting execution plan approval
Stop without activating developers until a human records execution plan gate approval
Quote YAML string values that contain colon-space or curly braces to avoid parser ambiguity
invariants: Planning only; do not implement product code
Do not compile without a current ready reconciliation baseline
Do not activate runtime before execution plan gate approval
Do not invent product intent or structure
Do not apply permission or allowlist changes without human action
